E2_RECOVERY_TIME.note: time for spread_bp to fall back within 10% of the trailing 3000-tick median

reproducibility_note: E1/E4 are re-runs of Phase-2 R1 A1/A2 under this frozen protocol

hypothesis_registry.feature: TI_PROXY = sum(sign(dmid), trailing 100 ticks)/sqrt(100)  [_PROXY: no size data]
hypothesis_registry.entry: next tick after the trigger tick
hypothesis_registry.comparison: re-run of Phase-2 R1 A1_TICKIMB_CONT (reproducibility check)

hypothesis_registry.feature: impact shock = |z(dmid over trailing 500 ticks)| >= 2 vs trailing 3000-tick std; reversion target = the mid at shock onset
hypothesis_registry.mechanism: after a price impact, liquidity replenishes and the mid recovers toward the pre-shock level
hypothesis_registry.extra: coefficient = recovered fraction (how much of the shock is given back by h), reported per spread regime

hypothesis_registry.feature: spread at shock onset vs trailing 3000-tick median
hypothesis_registry.metric: time (ms) until spread_bp returns within 10% of the trailing median; and the same conditioned on wide/normal spread at onset

hypothesis_registry.feature: joint cell = (spread tertile TIGHT/MID/WIDE from trailing q33/q67) x (rv500 tertile LOW/MID/HIGH) x (pressure sign of TI_PROXY)
hypothesis_registry.mechanism: the JOINT state carries information the marginals do not (interaction), i.e. a conditional drift
hypothesis_registry.trigger: the pressure sign is non-zero; entry on the tick at which the joint cell label is evaluated (every 500 ticks, deterministic grid to avoid overlapping spam)
hypothesis_registry.multiple_testing: 18 cells x 6 horizons; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 0.05 reported alongside the ladder

hypothesis_registry.feature: micro impulse = ret over trailing 100 ticks
hypothesis_registry.comparison: closest prior = Phase-2 R1 C2_ARRIVAL_BURST_CONT (different trigger, same direction class)

validation_method.bootstrap: block bootstrap over events, n=2000, blocks=50
validation_method.overlap_check: report raw event n, overlap ratio at each horizon, and effective_n = greedy non-overlapping event count
validation_method.VALIDATED_EDGE_requires: cost-adjusted gross > 0 at 1x on IS AND OOS, permutation p<0.05, bootstrap CI excludes 0, effective_n>=30, survives 2x cost, stable across sub-segments
validation_method.direction_policy: every directional source frozen BOTH ways

components.spread: MEASURED (0.18bp at calibration; snapshot median 0.34bp full spread)
components.slippage: MEASURED distribution from the 19-RT pilot; SIGNED, only the unfavorable leg counts
components.latency_cost: MEASURED (entry signal->fill median ~272ms) - not added as bp, reported separately
components.adverse_selection: MEASURED as the execution markout itself, not double-charged

E2_RECOVERY_TIME.note: time for spread_bp to fall back within 10% of the trailing 3000-tick median
E2_RECOVERY_TIME.reason: spread at shock onset is already within 10% of the trailing median for the vast majority of ticks, so the timer fires at j=i and returns 0; this measures nothing

validation_result.reason: every rated hypothesis stops at the ladder rung COST_INSUFFICIENT: the largest gross edge found (0.212 bp, E2 impact-recovery fade at 5s) is 23% of the 0.914 bp cost anchor; nothing is cost-adjusted positive, so VALIDATED_EDGE is not met

reproducibility.agreement: MATCH within rounding (same snapshot, same trigger |z500|>=2 onset, same fade direction)
reproducibility.DEFECT_FOUND_IN_R1: Phase-2 R1's A1_TICKIMB_CONT/REV passed a CONSTANT direction (+1/-1) into the evaluator instead of sign(TI_PROXY), so those two rows measured a fixed long/short, NOT the stated imbalance mechanism. E-R1's E1 implements the frozen definition correctly; the two are therefore NOT comparable, and R1's A1 rows must be considered mis-implemented rather than contradictory.
